boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same noun.

ops.en: the adaptation, representation, or presentation of something in dramatic form
ops.cn: 戏剧化改编；把故事、事件或材料改编、呈现为戏剧形式

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to represent, adapt, or present something in dramatic form
ops.cn: 把……改编成戏剧；以戏剧形式呈现

ops.en: figurative: to make an event, problem, or situation seem more dramatic, serious, emotional, or exciting than it really is
ops.cn: （比喻）夸大、戏剧化；使事情显得比实际更严重、更刺激或更情绪化

ops.en: the process of coming into existence, becoming visible or known, or gaining importance and prominence
ops.cn: 出现；兴起；逐渐形成、显现、为人所知或取得重要地位的过程

ops.en: shared cultural or ancestral identity, affiliation, or membership associated with heritage, language, customs, history, and related traditions
ops.cn: 族群身份；基于共同祖源、文化传统、语言、习俗、历史等形成的身份或归属

ops.en: the systematic assessment or judgment of the quality, effectiveness, performance, significance, condition, or value of something
ops.cn: 评估；对某事物的质量、效果、表现、意义、状态或价值进行系统判断

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to complete the final details of something or put it into its finished, final form
ops.cn: 完成定稿；敲定最后细节；使形成最终版本

ops.en: the ability or willingness to adapt, change, or adjust to different needs, conditions, or situations
ops.cn: 灵活性；适应变化、调整做法或满足不同需要的能力或意愿

ops.en: the ability of a material, body part, or object to bend or move without breaking or becoming permanently damaged
ops.cn: 柔韧性；材料、身体部位或物体弯曲活动而不折断或永久损坏的能力

ops.en: a person who establishes or starts an organization, institution, company, movement, or project
ops.cn: 创办人；创始人；建立组织、机构、公司、运动或项目的人

ops.en: to fail, collapse, or break down after struggling or losing stability
ops.cn: 失败；垮掉；因失去稳定或支撑而崩溃

ops.en: nautical: for a ship or boat to fill with water and sink
ops.cn: （航海）船进水沉没

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same noun.

ops.en: the process of increasing worldwide interconnectedness and integration across economies, societies, communication, culture, technology, and other systems
ops.cn: 全球化；经济、社会、通信、文化、技术等在世界范围内日益互联和整合的过程

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to form, propose, or state a hypothesis or tentative explanation that can be considered or tested
ops.cn: 提出假设；形成或陈述可供讨论、检验的暂时性解释

ops.meaning_cn: 假设……；对某事提出假说或暂时性解释

ops.en: supposed, imagined, or proposed for discussion, reasoning, testing, or illustration rather than being presented as actual fact
ops.cn: 假设的；设想的；为讨论、推理、检验或举例而提出而非作为既定事实的

ops.en: a lack of sufficient amount, quality, ability, effectiveness, or suitability for a particular need or task
ops.cn: 不足；不充分；数量、质量、能力、效果或适用性达不到某项需要或任务要求

ops.en: a tendency, preference, desire, or disposition toward something
ops.cn: 倾向；爱好；意愿；对某事具有的偏好或倾向性

ops.en: a slope, angle, or degree of leaning away from a vertical or horizontal position
ops.cn: 倾斜；斜度；偏离垂直或水平位置的角度

ops.en: not in agreement or logically compatible, or not remaining the same in behavior, quality, standard, or performance
ops.cn: 不一致的；相互矛盾的；行为、质量、标准或表现不稳定、不保持一致的

ops.en: the act or process of including, combining, or integrating something into a larger whole
ops.cn: 纳入；合并；把某物整合进更大整体的过程

ops.en: law/business: the legal formation or registration of a corporation or company as a separate legal entity
ops.cn: （法律/商业）公司法人化；把公司注册成立为独立法律实体的过程

ops.en: reasoning from specific observations, examples, or facts toward a broader general principle or conclusion
ops.cn: 归纳；从具体观察、例子或事实推导一般原则或结论的推理

ops.en: formal admission, introduction, or installation into a group, organization, office, or role
ops.cn: 正式加入；就职；被引入团体、组织、职务或角色的过程

ops.en: technical: the production or triggering of a process or effect, such as electromagnetic induction or induction of labor
ops.cn: （专业）诱导、感应；如电磁感应或引产

ops.en: the act or process of starting, introducing, or setting something in motion
ops.cn: 开始；启动；发起某事的过程

ops.en: formal admission or introduction into a group, role, organization, or ritual process
ops.cn: 入会；入门；正式加入团体、角色、组织或仪式程序

ops.en: lack of safety, stability, or protection; exposure to danger, uncertainty, or risk
ops.cn: 不安全；不稳定；缺乏保护而面临危险、不确定或风险的状态

ops.en: lack of self-confidence or self-assurance, or anxiety about oneself, relationships, acceptance, or status
ops.cn: 不自信；不安全感；对自己、关系、被接纳程度或地位感到焦虑

ops.en: relating to an institution, established organization, or entrenched system, structure, practice, or policy
ops.cn: 机构的；制度性的；与既有组织、系统、结构、惯例或政策有关的
